QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Erda Surge
QuestInfo.1:
An enormous amount of Erda is pouring out of the #bWorld's Sorrow#k. This downpour is known as the #bErda Surge#k and there will be clear signs before it happens. When you see it, #bhide beneath something#k sturdy so you won't be swept away. Monsters might appear and try to destroy your shelter, so don't let your guard down when you hide! After experiencing the Erda Surge, report to #b#p3003564##k to complete the Expedition mission.

The Erda Surge occurs #roccasionally#k during monster hunts. If you enter the field during the Erda Surge, you will not suffer its effects.
QuestInfo.2: You experienced the Erda Surge and completed the Expedition mission.
